notes: No a(n) is divisible by 2,5,13,29,31,37,41,43,53,71,97, proved in Lean (A213507_main) with a(n) = n! [x^n] (exp ℚ).subst(sum Catalan(n) x^n/n) (Mathlib PowerSeries.subst). Recurrence a(n+1) = sum_j n!/(n-j)! Catalan(j+1) a(n-j) from E' = L'E (a_eq_coeff). Bala's congruence in finite per-prime form: mod p terms j >= p vanish and n!/(n-j)! is 2p-periodic, so a(n+2p) = a(n) mod p once it holds for n < p (periodic); residues of a(0..3p-1) from a verified evaluator (tab_spec) run by decide +kernel (no native_decide). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Not in Lean, not needed: the e.g.f. identity C^2 exp(-xC^2) and Bala's congruence for composite k. Outside Lean: none.

Adds A213507_antiperiodic: a(n+p) = -a(n) (mod p) for each listed p and all n, as in the README's Result. Proof: mod p only terms j < p survive and n!/(n-j)! mod p is unchanged under n -> n+p, so the relation propagates from n < p (antiperiodic); the base a(n+p) + a(n) = 0 mod p for n < p is checked by decide +kernel (checkNeg) on the verified evaluator table (tab_spec). A213507_main as before (no a(n) divisible by the listed primes, a(n) = n! [x^n] (exp Q).subst(sum Catalan(n) x^n/n)). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; no native_decide.
